items.title: Ansible: An open-source automation tool that simplifies configuration management, application deployment, and task automation across multiple servers
Docker: A platform that enables developers to package applications and their dependencies into containers for consistent deployment across environments
GitHub: A cloud-based platform for version control and collaboration, using Git to track and manage code changes in repositories
Jenkins: An open-source automation server that enables continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) by automating software build, test, and deployment processes
Kubernetes: An open-source container orchestration platform for automating the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications
